keyword.en: why concrete pump distance changes with stone size
keyword.zh: 石子粒径不同时混凝土泵距离为什么分几行

title.en: Pipeline does not replace what Stone Size Changes the Printed Pumping Distance lists
title.zh: 「管道 (流體)」不能替换石子粒径不同时，印出的泵送距离为什么要分行列出的数字

description.en: Stone Size Changes the Printed Pumping Distance. 60 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Pipeline.
description.zh: 石子粒径不同时，印出的泵送距离为什么要分行。60 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「管道 (流體)」。

h1.en: Pipeline does not replace what Stone Size Changes the Printed Pumping Distance lists
h1.zh: 「管道 (流體)」不能替换石子粒径不同时，印出的泵送距离为什么要分行列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists more than one distance row on some concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 30 lists fine-stone 60 m / 180 m and aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的部分混凝土泵上标出了不止一行距离。电动30的细石为 60 m / 180 m，13骨料为 20 m / 60 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline: HDPE Pipeline in a harsh Australian environment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists more than one distance row on some concrete pumps in Xingtai. It lists one pair, 900 m / 300 m, beside aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Electric 60 lists fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm 150 m / 450 m and 24 mm 100 m / 300 m. Diesel 30 lists one pair, 60 m / 180 m, with aggregate 3 cm and below. If the page has no row for the stone you need, the entry is missing.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline页上的HDPE Pipeline in a harsh Australian environment。河北品锦机械在邢台的部分混凝土泵上标出了不止一行距离。电动30和电动40标出细石行和 13 骨料行。电动20只有一组 120 m / 40 m，骨料 1–2 cm。如果页面没有你需要的石子行，这一格就是缺失的。

body.en: Electric 30 lists fine-stone 60 m / 180 m and aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m. The coarse-stone row is not the fine-stone row with the numbers reused. The diesel mixer lists three rows too, with the first written as 100 / 300 m. Electric 80 lists one pair and a 24 mm aggregate note, not three rows. Ask through /en/contact/ rather than scaling a fine-stone pair by guesswork.
body.zh: 电动30的细石为 60 m / 180 m，13骨料为 20 m / 60 m。电动50标出细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。柴油30只有一组 60 m / 180 m，骨料 3 cm 及以下。请通过 /zh/contact/ 询问，不要靠猜测去缩放细石数对。

body.en: Electric 50, Electric 60 and Electric Low Pressure 60 add a 24 mm stone row. Electric 30 and Electric 40 list a fine-stone row and an aggregate-13 row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not say these rows are interchangeable. Do not paste Electric 60's 200 m / 600 m onto those single-pair pages. The factory is in Xingtai.
body.zh: 电动50、电动60和电动低压60另有 24 mm 石子行。电动60标出细石 200 m / 600 m、13 mm 150 m / 450 m、24 mm 100 m / 300 m。电动80只有一组距离，并有 24 mm 骨料说明，不是三行。

body.en: Electric 80 does not. Electric 50 lists fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. Electric 20 lists one pair, 120 m / 40 m, with aggregate 1–2 cm. Match the stone description in the row heading.
body.zh: 它只标出一组 900 m / 300 m，旁边的骨料是 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。柴油搅拌泵也标出三行，第一行写成 100 / 300 m。不要把电动60的 200 m / 600 m 贴到这些单组页面上。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list a 24 mm row?
question.zh: 电动30标出 24 mm 行吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 30 lists fine stone and aggregate-13 only, plus a maximum aggregate of ≤ 3 cm. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline.
answer.zh: 没有。电动30只标出细石和 13 骨料，另有最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: On the Electric 60 fine-stone row. It is not the 13 mm row and not the 24 mm row. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline.
answer.zh: 在电动60的细石行。它不是 13 mm 行，也不是 24 mm 行。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does Electric 80 use three stone rows?
question.zh: 电动80用三行石子距离吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 lists one H / V pair, 900 m / 300 m, and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline.
answer.zh: 不用。电动80只标出一组水平/垂直 900 m / 300 m，骨料为 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can I reuse a fine-stone pair for coarser stone?
question.zh: 可以把细石数对用到更粗的石子吗？

answer.en: Not from these sheets. When a coarser row exists, it lists its own metres. When it does not exist, leave it blank. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline.
answer.zh: 不能按这些参数页这样做。有更粗石子行时，它标出自己的米数。没有这一行时，保持空白。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pipeline画面里印出的数字。
